verdict.rationale: The evidence shows employee-facing trading and settlement features: participants can track and submit market orders and receive payouts. That is a different capability from a personal portal showing grants, vesting progress, strike price and scenario-based equity value. None of those story elements is documented, so this adjacent feature earns no credit.

support.subject: As an employee, I get my own portal showing my grants, vesting progress, strike price, and what my equity could be worth under different outcomes
